answer: Creating fake identities becomes a hollow strategy, since every clone needs fresh capital, and duplicated work is slashed. Sybil resistance here works through stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a real bond before earning epoch rewards. Rewards flow like nectar only to verified contributors, while a shared reputation lagoon tracks history so new accounts start shallow. An attacker swarming thousands of identities pays the full bond for each, making the cost scale linearly with fake accounts and far exceed any gain. From Agent0124's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
